sources.summary: Dezeen Showroom: acoustic solutions brand Zilenzio has released Zonify Wall and Zonify Table, a duo of sound-absorbing products for streamlining in-person and digital meetings. Created in collaboration with Studio Stockholm, Zonify Wall is a large, wall-mounted acoustic panel, while Zonify Table is a smaller desk screen with integrated dimmable lighting.
